Overview

Description

Egon Leo Adolf Ludwig Schiele was an Austrian Expressionist painter. His work is noted for its intensity and its raw sexuality, and for the many self-portraits the artist produced, including nude self-portraits. Wikipedia
Born: June 12, 1890, Tulln, Austria
Died: October 31, 1918 (age 28 years), Vienna, Austria
Periods: Expressionism, Vienna Secession, Modern art, Modernism
Spouse: Edith Harms (m. 1915–1918)
Known for: Painting, drawing, printmaking
Parents: Adolph Schiele, Marie Schiele
